review_notes: I read the whole target file. Inside it the helper lemmas already factor the repeated reasoning, and the two big computations in `main` (`hsum` and the final q-coefficient identity) only share routine sigma/subtype/split_ifs bookkeeping, so I did not report them. I grepped the repository and found the same Nebentypus closure lemmas (zero/add/smul/sum) proved again in other Sol files. I read two of those copies, in S_CuspForm_exists_qCoeff_eq_sum_isPrimitiveForm_of_hasNebentypus.lean and S_CuspForm_exists_isPrimitiveForm_basis_gammaH_….lean. The Definitions/ and Theorems/ directories have no shared versions. I read only part of each other file, so I haven't confirmed that every variant (Γ₁ℝ N versus Gamma1 N coercions, Type versus Type*) can be replaced by one shared statement. The finding is about duplication across files rather than within this file. I could not check compilation of the proposed refactor.

theorem hasNebentypus_sum {ε : DirichletCharacter ℂ L} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → CuspForm Γ₁(L) k) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, CuspForm.HasNebentypus ε (f i)) :
    CuspForm.HasNebentypus ε (∑ i ∈ s, f i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
findings.problem: The same closure facts for `CuspForm.HasNebentypus` (zero, add, smul, and finite sums by `Finset.induction_on`) are proved again in several Sol files with essentially identical proofs. Examples are the `intro γ hγ τ; simp only [CuspForm.add_apply]; rw [hf γ hγ τ, hg γ hγ τ]; ring` proof of add, the `simp only [CuspForm.IsGLPos.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; rw [hf ..]; ring` proof of smul, and the induction proof of sum. `qCoeff_sum` is likewise reproved in many files. Each copy depends on the local definition of `HasNebentypus`, so a change to that definition or to the simp lemmas would have to be repeated in every copy. The target also carries the full induction argument for the sum lemma.
findings.proposed_change: Put the lemmas once in a shared module that imports Definitions.Def_CuspForm_PrimitiveFormGamma1, for example next to the `HasNebentypus` definition or in P2M/Util. State them as `CuspForm.HasNebentypus.zero`, `.add`, `.smul` and `.sum`, with `{M : ℕ} {k : ℤ} {ε : DirichletCharacter ℂ M}` and forms on `Gamma1 M`. The proofs are the current add/smul/zero proofs. The sum lemma can be one line with `Finset.sum_induction _ (CuspForm.HasNebentypus ε) (fun _ _ => .add) (.zero ..) hf`. Alternatively, package `{g | HasNebentypus ε g}` as a `Submodule ℂ (CuspForm (Gamma1 M) k)` and use `Submodule.sum_mem`. Also share `qCoeffLin`, `qCoeff_add`, `qCoeff_smul` and `qCoeff_sum` the same way. Then lines 56–85 here (and the matching blocks in S_CuspForm_exists_qCoeff_eq_sum_isPrimitiveForm_of_hasNebentypus.lean lines 285–320 and S_CuspForm_exists_isPrimitiveForm_basis_gammaH_….lean lines 207–229) are deleted. The uses in `main` become `CuspForm.HasNebentypus.sum _ _ fun i hi => (hεb ..).smul _` and `(hGε x.1 x.2).smul _`, with the same hypotheses as now. The `hasNebentypus_smul` argument order differs between files (`hf c` versus `c hf`), so the call sites need small edits.
findings.benefit: The Nebentypus closure proofs live in one place. Each Sol file then only contains its own mathematics, and `main` here becomes easier to read. A future change to `HasNebentypus` or to the slash-action simp lemmas needs one fix, not one per file.
